name: Pembrokeshire Foodbank - Narberth
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank serving Boncath area
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network covering Pembrokeshire. Nearest distribution at Liberty Cafe

name: Field of Beans Community Garden
short_description: Community garden in Boncath founded by local resilience group
description: Started by Fynnone Resilience group after covid to provide growing space for residents. Offers plots for local residents to grow their own vegetables and fruit. Open daily during growing season.
